title: Divine Mercy: For the Sake of His Sorrowful Passion
text:
For the sake of His sorrowful Passion,
have mercy on us and on the whole world.
attribution: Chaplet of Divine Mercy (St. Faustina Kowalska)
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Pro dolorosa Eius Passione, miserere nobis et totius mundi.
